Overview # This project details the architecture and deployment of an automated SIEM homelab. The primary goal was to create a reproducible environment for testing threat hunting hypotheses and developing custom detections.
The lab utilizes Elastic Stack for log aggregation and Security Onion for network visibility.

Project Summary # Managing vulnerabilities efficiently requires more than just looking at a CVSS score. This project involves a custom Python script that aggregates data from multiple frameworks (CVSS, SSVC, EPSS, and CISA KEV) to generate a realistic prioritization queue.
By factoring in environmental context and active exploitation metrics, the tool reduces the noise of false positives.
GitHub repository and methodology breakdown coming soon.
